brief.t: Do first: Coast Southwest invoice, P O twenty twenty six dash zero zero zero four, is marked urgent. Jessica says the order is ready to ship the moment funds land. That is raw material stuck on the dock holding up production. Release the payment or tell me why not.

Ephix is going cold on our silence. Desiree at Hawke Media has now pinged you twice on the July sixth kickoff follow up, asking for your status and timeline. Give me one line and I will reply for you today before this account cools off.

Victor Armendarez is overdue since July tenth, eighty seven percent close, N D A signed. Still blocked on Ronald's raw ingredient costs. Say the word and I nudge Ronald this morning. And confirm: is seventy five percent margin just for Victor or the new standard.

Big win. The ConvertFlow lead capture is fixed and live. Leads fired to us overnight for the first time ever. First real one to route is Hariett at H B I Salon, a hair loss shampoo, masque and serum project, five hundred to a thousand units. I am wiring these straight into your Outlook so the Email Agent works them.

Facility is moving. Landlord approved the double doors and epoxy floors, the lease amendment number one is ready for your signature, and the mover pushed the date to the twenty eighth and is sending paperwork today. Sign the amendment and watch for the mover contract.
Customer care: Shopify order fourteen forty five from Sherman Howard is a zero dollar warranty replacement, beard shampoos and a broken oil. Quick win, just confirm it is being fulfilled.

CRM developer went quiet overnight. No ready for verification on the deals pipeline, no API reply, and four tickets still open. I am keeping the heat on and will verify and regression check the second anything lands. Good news, the ISO twenty two seven sixteen project is signed at fourteen thousand seven hundred, so G M P certification is officially moving.

kb.a: Coast Southwest sent proforma invoice P O twenty twenty six dash zero zero zero four, marked high importance. Jessica Gutierrez says the order is ready to ship pending funds and will release once payment is received. This is a raw material order blocking production. Needs Sam's payment decision.

Desiree Moore at Hawke Media has checked in twice on the July sixth Ephix kickoff follow up, asking for Sam's current status and timeline so they can plan next steps. Account is at risk of cooling from our silence. Needs one line of status from Sam so the agent can reply.

Victor Armendarez, eighty seven percent close, N D A signed. Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel, six ounce jar, two thousand units each. Quote overdue since July tenth, still blocked on Ronald's raw ingredient cost per unit, plus packaging and fill labor. Margin was set at seventy five percent but Sam needs to confirm whether that is Victor only or the new P L L standard versus the usual sixty five.

The ConvertFlow lead capture webhook is fixed and live as of July sixteenth. The old webhook was set to the wrong trigger and never fired. Leads now flow to the agent and are being routed into Sam's Outlook so the Email Agent works them. First real lead is Hariett at H B I Salon dot com, a custom hair loss shampoo, masque and serum, five hundred to a thousand units. There are also about a hundred and five contacts sitting in ConvertFlow uncontacted, awaiting Sam's go ahead to sort real buyers from junk.

Facility move is progressing. Landlord Richard Kerwin approved installing the double doors to the back of the building and the epoxy floors. Lease Amendment number one for 24600 North Industrial Drive is ready for Sam to sign and return. The mover, Michigan Office Movers, pushed the move date to the twenty eighth and is sending paperwork. Still open from the agent: total building square footage and production zone square footage, and whether any products are aerosol, since Elior dry shampoo as aerosol would trigger mandatory sprinklers.

Shopify order fourteen forty five from Sherman Howard Junior is a zero dollar warranty replacement, two beard shampoos with damaged labels and one beard oil replacing a broken one. Quick customer care item, just needs fulfillment confirmed.

The ISO twenty two seven sixteen G M P certification project was signed on July sixteenth at fourteen thousand seven hundred dollars. Aidan negotiated and closed it. This puts the G M P certification path officially in motion for the new facility.

No developer movement overnight. Still waiting on ready for verification for the deals pipeline Option A build, the API build reply, and four open tickets: Laura's CRM access, the formula ingredient upload bug, the production pipeline blank screen, and the raw materials pricing fallback logic. The agent will verify each fix live and regression check adjacent features before closing anything.

Raul Guardado sent STRUCK box art revisions: the bottle size should be corrected to twenty milliliters, remove the ounces data as redundant, and add the Made in USA flag clipart that is on the bottle. Routed to Laura. Agent is confirming she is on it.

Elmar Nasibov, three product pricing: Hydrating Mist, Peptide Cream, and Hydrating Serum. Ronald's raw ingredient costs are in but packaging, labor and overhead are still needed to compute the all in price and confirm margin. Reply goes out by WhatsApp once complete.

Elior dry shampoo quote for five hundred and a thousand units. CRM task created, high priority. Still need from Sam: aerosol or non aerosol, Ronald's B O M, packaging type, and margin at sixty five or seventy five. Aerosol matters because it triggers H occupancy and mandatory sprinklers at the new facility.

Ben Kar of Tavro, ninety percent close, about thirty thousand units of custom tallow and argan oil. Proposal has still never been sent. Agent drafts, Sam reviews, then it fires once by WhatsApp and email.

Nadia Dupuis at Oreka Skincare: quote Q dash zero zero zero seven is accepted. Three cleanup steps ready pending Sam's confirm: log the eight thousand five hundred fifty five dollar payment, open the production job for a thousand units of Peptide Cream, and delete the orphan Peptide Serum formula on Q dash zero zero zero six. Nikkie's commission folds in once the production job opens.

Ronald owes several answers: Aran Beauty scent samples in Vanilla, Jasmine, Rose and Sweet Orange, plus raw ingredient costs for Victor and Elior. Agent is ready to nudge him via Team Chat on Sam's go ahead.

Aidan is still overdue on the number one revenue task, Kenna Pure Good and Terra Lotus pricing, due July eighth, now more than a week late. Good news, Aidan just signed the ISO twenty two seven sixteen certification deal. Agent to nudge him on the overdue pricing via Team Chat.

Standing data problem: quotes in the CRM carry raw ingredient cost only. Packaging, fill labor and overhead rates must be added before any quote is trustworthy. Ronald's B O M numbers are ingredients only and must never be quoted as is.
Raanan Rosenbaum of Raanan Media booked a thirty minute call with Sam for nine thirty A M Eastern on Thursday July twenty third.
